fields: as the router: cols (situation, what you need, start with), rows [situation, need, {t, link, intent}]. A row with more than three cells shows the middle ones as further "need" lines.
best_for: NumeralIndex sets a router table as a Swiss index of situations, each under a huge light outline numeral with its start page as a square go-cell, so a reader finds their situation by scanning large type rather than a table.
